documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Clarification sought from Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd
Intimation Of Grant Of Options Under OFSS Stock Plan 2014

analysis.summary: Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of ₹76,721 million and net income of ₹26,4 billion for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹400 per share for FY 2025-26 and did not recommend any additional final dividend. During the year, the company accelerated its AI-led innovation agenda, expanded its cloud services portfolio, and maintained strong financial discipline with an operating margin of 44%. Total employee headcount stood at 9,155 as of March 31, 2026. Oracle Financial Services Software Limited reported consolidated revenues of 68.5 billion for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, representing a 7% growth over the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape was shaped by dynamic global developments, evolving geo-political conditions, and accelerating technology trends, creating a market environment that rewarded resilience and innovation.

demand_outlook.claim: The business landscape during the financial year was driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends leading to demand challenges in the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced an increasing demand for its cloud-native banking solutions.
demand_outlook.quote: Driven by an increasing demand for our cloud-native banking solutions, our License & Cloud revenues grew 13% over financial year 2023-24.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that banks are under intense pressure to deliver digital delight at scale while complying with regulations at the lowest possible cost.
demand_outlook.quote: With an increasingly tech savvy customer base which is spoilt for choice, banks are under intense pressure to deliver “digital delight” at scale with complete compliance to regulations and at the lowest possible cost.

demand_outlook.claim: Financial institutions are increasingly seeking solutions on new cloud-compatible architectures adaptable to rapid change.
demand_outlook.quote: Banks are increasingly looking at solutions delivered on a new architecture which is adaptable to rapid change and is available on the cloud.

capex_expansion.claim: The company significantly expanded its cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with several product launches during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we significantly expanded our cloud services portfolio for the banking industry with the launch of Oracle Banking Retail Lending Servicing Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Collections Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Cash Management Cloud Service, Oracle Banking Supply Chain Management Cloud Service, and Oracle Banking Trade Finance Cloud Service.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintained strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%.
margins_costs.quote: We also continued to maintain strong financial discipline, resulting in an operating margin of 44%, reflecting the Company's consistent focus on execution and operational efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: The net margin for the financial year was 35%.
margins_costs.quote: The net income for the financial year was ₹ 23.8 billion, a 7% increase, and the net margin was 35%.

margins_costs.claim: The operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% compared to 42% in the last financial year.
margins_costs.quote: We continued to maintain a strong financial discipline while driving the growth, and our operating margin for the financial year rose to 44% as compared to 42% in the last financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company signed a number of multi-million dollar deals with marquee customers across the world which are a testimony to the excellence of our products through continuing R&D, our track record of delivering high quality implementations, and providing reliable support.

orders_capacity.claim: The company recorded license wins of $137 million, marking the highest ever for the company and a 44% growth over the prior fiscal year.
orders_capacity.quote: The fiscal year 2024 saw license wins of $137M – highest ever for the Company, registering a 44% growth over last fiscal.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board approved two interim dividends totaling ₹ 400 per share for FY 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has not recommended any additional final dividend for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has not recommended any additional final dividend for the financial year 2025-26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not transferred any amount to the reserves during the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved an interim dividend of 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, which was 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the previous financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board was pleased to approve an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per share for the financial year 2024-25, 10.4% higher than the dividend paid in the last financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared an interim dividend of 265 per equity share of 5 each on April 25, 2025, for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, and did not recommend any additional final dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company ("the Board") declared an interim dividend of ₹ 265 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on April 25, 2025, for the financial year ended March 31, 2025. They have not recommended any additional final dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: During the financial year 2024-25, the company did not accept any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2024-25, the Company has not accepted any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act, and as such, no amount of principal or interest on deposits was outstanding as of the date of the Balance Sheet.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors declared an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per equity share of ₹ 5 each for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company declared an interim dividend of ₹ 240 per equity share of ₹ 5 each on April 24, 2024, for the financial year ended March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not accept any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act during the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: During the financial year 2023-24, the Company has not accepted any deposits within the meaning of Sections 73 and 76 of the Act and as such, no amount of principal or interest was outstanding as of the date of the Balance Sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global uncertainties, geo-political challenges, and shifting technology trends led to demand challenges in the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the financial year, the business landscape continued to be driven by global uncertainties, geo-political challenges and shifting technology trends - all leading to demand challenges in the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fiscal year 2024 encountered several uncertainties including geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, bank failures in the west, and tectonic technology shifts.
risks_headwinds.quote: Fiscal year 2024 was fraught with several uncertainties including continued and expanding geopolitical conflicts, economic slowdowns, highly visible failures of some banks in the western world, and tectonic technology shifts with increasing usage of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) and machine learning (ML).

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation, and maintaining the highest standards of governance.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to delivering sustainable value, pioneering innovation and maintaining the highest standards of governance.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
